description: Search bestbuy.ca by keyword and get Canadian prices by province: CAD price, regular price, savings, sale end date, ratings, marketplace seller, online stock count and store pickup status. Use it for electronics price comparison in Canada, deal and sale tracking, or stock checks. Runs the Apify Actor loudtzu/bestbuy-ca-product-search on your own Apify account (pay per event: $0.0006 per product, billed by Apify; Apify platform usage may apply). Store page: https://apify.com/loudtzu/bestbuy-ca-product-search

fetchAll.description: Fetch all results. Ignore Max products and save everything (up to 50,000).

includeAvailability.description: Include stock. Add online stock status, units remaining online and pickup status (one extra request per 24 products, no extra charge).

keywords.description: Search terms. Words to search on bestbuy.ca. Example: ["laptop"]

language.description: Language. Language of names and descriptions.

maxItems.description: Max products. Total products across all search terms (split evenly).

maxItemsPerQuery.description: Max products per search term. Optional fixed limit per search term. 0 = split evenly.

postalCode.description: Postal code for stock. Used for the online stock and pickup lookup. Default M5G 2C3 (Toronto).

province.description: Province. Prices are shown for this province (regional pricing).

runOptions.description: Optional run limits (not passed to the Actor). maxTotalChargeUsd caps what this single call can cost you on Apify.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Hard cap in USD for this run's Actor charges. Defaults to the server's MAX_CHARGE_USD (1.00 unless set).

timeoutSecs.description: Run timeout in seconds (Apify's synchronous limit is 300).

skipMarketplace.description: Skip marketplace sellers. Leave out products sold by third-party marketplace sellers (not charged).

name: bestbuy_ca_product_search
title: Best Buy Canada product prices
